overview: A responsive personal finance tracker with receipt scanning, budget categories, expense logging, recurring templates, analytics charts, annual summary, budget alerts, dark/light mode, and notes — all in Namibian dollars (N$).
features: Receipt scanning with camera to auto-fill expense amounts via OCR
Budget categories with monthly spending limits and color-coded progress bars
Expense logging with receipt photo attachments
Analytics charts: trend, pie, budget vs actual, daily spending
